tests.title: Browser: portal capture 5 pages

tests.title: Cron stress: all 6 smoke crons single fire

tests.title: Cron stress: git-sync 4 fires over 1h
tests.description: Fires smoke-git-sync-cron every 15m for 1h (4 fires at +0/15/30/45m); writes cron_runs>=4 + cron_run_outputs>=4; bumps catalog last_green.

tests.title: Cron stress: artifact-save 20x rapid
tests.description: Loops smoke-artifact-save-cron 20x with no sleep; writes cron_runs x20 (distinct tick_id) + cron_run_outputs x20.

tests.title: Cron stress: prd-index last_green monotonic

tests.title: Cron stress: fault + partial mix
tests.description: Fires smoke-fault-cron (exit!=0) + smoke-partial-cron (delivered=false); writes cron_runs fail_count>=1 + skipped_count>=1; run_outputs error + failed_silent.

tests.title: Cron stress: real-model manager + traces
tests.description: Fires smoke-morning-brief + smoke-sprint-manager via --backend hermes --model gpt-5-mini (token-bearing); writes langfuse_traces x2 + cron_runs total_cost_usd>0 + run_outputs trace_id.

tests.title: Cron stress: 36-tick fleet soak
tests.description: Fires all 6 crons x 6 hourly buckets (36 fires, stub backend); writes cron_runs x36 + cron_run_outputs x36; catalog 6 green.

tests.title: Cron stress: host-job-run.v1 leg
tests.description: Fires a smoke cron and verifies the host-job-run.v1 leg via insert_host_job_run_to_supabase.py; writes host_job_runs (host_class=mac-mini).

tests.title: Cron stress: 4 crons in parallel
tests.description: Fires 4 smoke crons in PARALLEL (lock + insert atomicity stress); writes cron_runs x4 + cron_run_outputs x4 + host_job_runs x4.

tests.title: Artifact-save managed cron
tests.description: Captures session artifacts into the registry; managed via run_managed_cron.py. Backfilled for smoke coverage (had no test before).

tests.title: Git-sync managed cron
tests.description: Stages-exact-paths and pushes a WIP snapshot, emitting a JSON landing summary; managed via run_managed_cron.py.

tests.title: Morning-brief managed cron
tests.description: Rolls up the daily morning-brief feed digest; managed via run_managed_cron.py.

tests.title: PRD-index managed cron

tests.title: Sprint-manager managed cron
tests.description: Reconciles sprint/Kanban state; managed via run_managed_cron.py.

tests.title: Stale-browser managed cron
tests.description: Recovers a stale browser-harness session; managed via run_managed_cron.py.

tests.title: Failure: 429 backoff then give-up
tests.description: Fires smoke-backoff-cron simulating 429 retry/backoff then give-up; writes cron_runs fail/skip + cron_run_outputs status=timeout, payload.attempts.

tests.title: Failure: blocked gate + blocker link
tests.description: Dispatches a team with a missing hard_gate -> blocked card + blocker link; writes agent_runs status blocked + prd_kanban_dispatch_links relationship blocker.

tests.title: Failure: circuit-breaker trip -> paused
tests.description: Consecutive smoke-fail-cron fails trip the breaker; hermes_cron_catalog.state flips to paused (stale last_green_at + fail streak).

tests.title: Failure: smoke-fail-cron exit 1 x12
tests.description: Fires smoke-fail-cron LIVE (tool exit 1) looped 12x; writes cron_runs fail_count=1 + cron_run_outputs error + agent_runs failed card + catalog.

tests.title: Failure: ok->failed host-receipt edge
tests.description: Writes sequential host receipts ok then failed (ok->failed edge) via insert_host_job_run_to_supabase.py; writes host_job_runs 1 ok + 1 failed.

tests.title: Failure: push-failed receipt replay
tests.description: Writes host-job receipts with .push-failed.json sidecars then runs replay_failed_host_job_receipts.py (3 sidecars); writes host_job_runs on replay.

tests.title: Failure: throwing smoke skill error
tests.description: Runs a throwing smoke skill under the universal hook -> status=error; writes skill_runs status error + skill_outputs error payload (10 err / 5 ok mix).

tests.title: Failure: crash storm dedup + alert
tests.description: Writes ~25 crashed agent_runs for ONE task then runs kanban_crash_storm_alert.py --threshold 20.

tests.title: Lineage: 3 concurrent threads
tests.description: Seeds 3 distinct smoke PRDs (3 nonces) and drives all three through the funnel concurrently; writes prd_artifacts x3 + dispatch_links x3 + agent_runs ~3x9 cards.

tests.title: Lineage: cost rollup integrity
tests.description: Runs the token-bearing thread variant (hermes_tac_team_runner --backend hermes --model gpt-5-mini for the build leg); writes langfuse_traces (total_cost>0) + tac_build_runs (total_cost_usd) + host_job_runs.

tests.title: Lineage: failure thread (blocked validator)
tests.description: Seeds ONE smoke PRD whose dispatch carries a failing hard_gate; runs the same funnel; writes prd_artifacts + dispatch_links (blocker) + agent_runs (validator blocked).

tests.title: Lineage: golden happy-path thread
tests.description: Seeds ONE fixture PRD (unique nonce slug -> deterministic prd_id) and drives the full funnel; writes prd_artifacts -> prd_kanban_dispatch_links -> agent_runs(board) -> tac_build_runs -> langfuse_traces -> report.

tests.title: Lineage: taxonomy survival (domain/service/client_tier triple)
tests.description: Seeds ONE PRD carrying a (domain,service,client_tier) frontmatter triple; threads frontmatter -> dispatch evidence -> Kanban labels -> obs_smoke_taxonomy pills via golden_thread.py taxonomy-survival.

tests.title: Lineage: tag correction (re-tag with provenance)
tests.description: Seeds ONE deliberately mis-tagged PRD; a normalization step re-tags it; tracks before->after via golden_thread.py tag-correction.

tests.title: Lineage: cross-taxonomy aggregation (3 domains, 1 sprint)
tests.description: Seeds 3 PRDs of distinct domain sharing one sprint_id; asserts the per-domain breakdown sums correctly via golden_thread.py cross-taxonomy-agg.

tests.title: Lineage: sprint composition (correlation key = sprint_id)
tests.description: Batches N PRDs into one sprint and asserts all N fan out from and back into the same sprint_id via golden_thread.py sprint-composition.

tests.title: Lineage: reprioritization (P2 -> P0 mid-sprint)
tests.description: A PRD enters P2 and the sprint manager promotes it to P0 mid-sprint; tracks the priority-change event via golden_thread.py reprioritization.

tests.title: Lineage: sprint carryover (same prd_id across sprint N -> N+1)
tests.description: The same prd_id carries from sprint N to N+1; asserts carryover recorded in both sprint reports with a provenance edge via golden_thread.py sprint-carryover.

tests.title: Lineage: sprint retro (headline == sum of board card states)
tests.description: The sprint manager closes a sprint and emits a retro; reconciles per-PRD board end-states into a velocity rollup via golden_thread.py sprint-retro.

tests.title: Lineage: WIP capacity (admitted vs deferred)
tests.description: Feeds more PRDs than the WIP limit and tracks admitted vs deferred via golden_thread.py wip-capacity.

tests.title: Lineage: fan-out / fan-in (one PRD -> N agents -> one dossier)
tests.description: One PRD fans out to a TAC team of N agents and back into one reconciled dossier via golden_thread.py fan-out-fan-in.

tests.title: Lineage: isolation negative-control (smoke vs decoy tenant)
tests.description: Runs the smoke thread alongside an in-memory tenant:__not-smoke decoy and proves the obs view filters the decoy out at every stage via golden_thread.py isolation-negative (decoy is never persisted).

tests.title: Lineage: report cited-id fidelity
tests.description: After the happy-path producer, runs extract_agent_team_report.py / render_tac_report_package.py + build_plan_execution_dossiers.py; writes host_job_runs (render-gate-lineage-fidelity receipt listing cited ids).

tests.title: Lineage: wall-clock monotonic stages
